meta.title: Portuguese to English Voice Translator | IQ Translate

hero.title: Portuguese to English translator
hero.description: The two sides of Portuguese sound very different and often choose different words. Record or paste either one and read the English, then answer in English and send it back in Portuguese.

items.q: Does it work for both Brazilian and European Portuguese?
items.a: Yes. Both are recognised and translated from the sentence itself, including the vocabulary differences between them.
Play the note out loud into the mic and the English transcript appears a couple of seconds later — no typing involved.
Yes, switch to the keyboard and paste a message, an email or a document, accents and cedillas included.
Yes. Your English is translated to Portuguese in the same conversation and can be played aloud for the other person.
Informal words are read in the context of the whole sentence, which is how they get the meaning the speaker intended.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.
